Re-run 16:49 JST after review (3/3 judged parts pass, as in 3 earlier runs). (a) passed on its then: device clock 23:58 -> M1, fast-forward past midnight -> M2; server has M1 once under 'Oct 14 (prior)', M2 alone in Most Recent, panel 'Oct 14 (prior) 1 lines' + 'Most Recent 1 lines'. (b)/(c) pass but are only PARTLY covered: the spec writes the recovery record and reopens the chart, so the failed line is neither in the open page's live transcript nor on the server and the app always takes the 'not held, append' branch; the re-append vs 'already archived' decision the oracle names (failed line still in the open page, most at risk after midnight) never runs and needs the cloud recording/transcription path. Not a plain pass because (a)'s then conflicts with U9 (UAT 3.8, not gated): only the device crossed midnight - the server day was still 2026-10-14 (UTC and Tokyo) - yet the stored transcriptDate is 'Thu Oct 15 2026' (the device's day) and M1 became a prior entry. 产品问题: If U9 governs: a physician whose device clock has passed midnight while the server's day has not (wrong clock, or a device ahead of the server day) records a bedside line; the line before it is moved to 'Oct 14 (prior)' and the new one is filed under the device's date (transcriptDate 'Thu Oct 15 2026' while the server day is 2026-10-14), for every device on the account. useEncounterCapture uses the device clock for the transcript day. Breaks UAT 3.8 / TC-16 U9 ('when a transcript becomes a prior entry ... use the server clock'); same root as the wrong-clock step of TC-16 S19 (a new finding against TFA-92594 per that oracle).

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B18 · P1 · 已知

很多时间和日期按设备时钟算，没有用服务器时间（违反 UAT 3.8）：「NEW TODAY」、入院日期、体征日期、任务完成时间、转录日期都跟着手机走；手机慢两天时停药被打成两天前，下次清理就把这个药删了

票：TFA-92584 ready for qa（UAT 3.8） · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

注：根因已知（Daniela 10-03 提过要用服务器时间）；删药、掉标签、草稿恢复错这几个症状是新的

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28

思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S25 「客户端开着病历跨过午夜：实时录音和恢复的失败保存，每行都只列一次（新的 Playwright spec）」 Client crosses midnight with a chart open: a live recording and a recovered failed save each list every line once (new Playwright spec)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 Nothing invented or doubled: the list holds only lines that were recorded or dictated, with no added line (e.g. 'Encounter completed.') and no line listed twice.（UAT 3.4）
  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 How it works 1；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • U9 Time-based rules (what counts as today and yesterday, when a transcript becomes a prior entry, when it leaves) use the server clock. …（UAT 3.8）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Chromium with page.clock installed at 23:58 local, the mocked speech recognizer (installSpeechRecognitionMock), a fresh Hospital patient. (a) Record M1 at 23:58, let page.clock run past midnight, record M2. …

When After each part, read rounding.get and open Prior Encounter Transcripts

Then (a) M1 once, in '<day> (prior)'; M2 alone in 'Most Recent'. (b) The recovered line once, in 'Most Recent'. (c) The recovered line once, in exactly one session

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U11 (no line twice) and U1 (not lost), from UAT 3.4 and TC-16. rounding.get history / transcript equality plus row counts, as prior-transcripts.spec.ts asserts. Covers the client half of the midnight fix (useEncounterCapture.ts transcriptDayRef) and the recovery branch at useEncounterCapture.ts:362-395, which decides re-append vs already archived; the server half is S17. …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-c（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela；Allure 状态按分诊从 passed 改成 failed。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92594 ready for qa

手机时钟比服务器先过午夜时，前一条转写被移到「Oct 14 (prior)」，新的一条按手机日期（10/15）存，所有设备都这样显示。

If a phone's clock passes midnight before the server's day does, the earlier line moves to 'Oct 14 (prior)' and the new line is filed under the phone's date (Oct 15) on every device.

依据：Allure 1f6a04f9, newspec-c record-only. Parts (a)/(b)/(c) pass as written; (b)/(c) are only partly covered. S25's then expects the device-day roll, but TC-16 U9 / UAT 3.8 say the server clock decides. useEncounterCapture uses the device clock. TC-16 Q9 is open. Same class as TC-19/S19.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-c。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-c。

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S25

Client crosses midnight with a chart open: a live recording and a recovered failed save each list every line once (new Playwright spec)

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

本地新 lane newspec-c：newspec-c/results.json 里 status record-only → 通过（只记录（判过的都通过；带一个待定的产品问题，写在说明里））。

怎么测（newspec-c/plan.json，automatable: partly）：New Playwright spec, fresh account, browser clock at 23:58 local (page.clock), the e2e speech-recognition mock. (a) record M1, fast-forward past midnight, record M2. (b)/(c) the first rounding:update that carries the bedside line fails at the socket; the device's recovery record for that line is then written to IndexedDB exactly as the cloud engine stores it (localAudio.ts) and the chart is reopened, which is when the app offers 'Recover bedside recording'; (c) moves the clock to the next day first. After each part rounding:get (JWT) and the Prior Encounter Transcripts rows. — (a) is fully automated. (b)/(c) are partly covered: the on-device test recogniser keeps no audio, so the spec writes the recovery record and reopens the chart; after the reload the failed line is neither in liveTranscriptRef nor on the server, so only the 'not held, append' branch of recoverAudio runs and (c) cannot fail on the midnight risk it was written for. The re-append vs 'already archived' branch (failed line still in the open page's live transcript) needs the cloud recording/transcription path (Chromium has a fake mic; the blocker is the cloud engine, not a microphone); it stays with the dictation runner / manual. (a)'s then expects the device-midnight roll while U9 (UAT 3.8) says server clock: the U9 comparison is recorded only, for Quinn.

Detail:

Re-run 16:49 JST after review (3/3 judged parts pass, as in 3 earlier runs). (a) passed on its then: device clock 23:58 -> M1, fast-forward past midnight -> M2; server has M1 once under 'Oct 14 (prior)', M2 alone in Most Recent, panel 'Oct 14 (prior) 1 lines' + 'Most Recent 1 lines'. (b)/(c) pass but are only PARTLY covered: the spec writes the recovery record and reopens the chart, so the failed line is neither in the open page's live transcript nor on the server and the app always takes the 'not held, append' branch; the re-append vs 'already archived' decision the oracle names (failed line still in the open page, most at risk after midnight) never runs and needs the cloud recording/transcription path. Not a plain pass because (a)'s then conflicts with U9 (UAT 3.8, not gated): only the device crossed midnight - the server day was still 2026-10-14 (UTC and Tokyo) - yet the stored transcriptDate is 'Thu Oct 15 2026' (the device's day) and M1 became a prior entry. S25's then expects that roll; U9 says the server clock decides. Quinn to rule which governs (cross-reference TC-16 S19, the wrong-clock phone step).

产品问题：If U9 governs: a physician whose device clock has passed midnight while the server's day has not (wrong clock, or a device ahead of the server day) records a bedside line; the line before it is moved to 'Oct 14 (prior)' and the new one is filed under the device's date (transcriptDate 'Thu Oct 15 2026' while the server day is 2026-10-14), for every device on the account. useEncounterCapture uses the device clock for the transcript day. Breaks UAT 3.8 / TC-16 U9 ('when a transcript becomes a prior entry ... use the server clock'); same root as the wrong-clock step of TC-16 S19 (a new finding against TFA-92594 per that oracle).

证据：附了 5 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our Playwright spec under tools/qa-agent, not written yet): page.clock across local midnight, installSpeechRecognitionMock, failFirstMutationRequest on rounding:update and rounding.get reads on a fresh local account (admin key).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
